title: The Forge Quest
description: The Explorer has recognized the scroll's forge clue! Forge a magnet at the Toolmaster and use it to fish the relic shard at the pyramid's pool. The magnet will break the magnetic lock.
fishingTip: Fish the relic shard at the pyramid's pool using your magnet. The magnetic lock should break when you use it!

objectives.description: Fish the relic shard at the pyramid's pool using your magnet

rewards.description: You've successfully retrieved the relic shard from the pyramid pool - one of three pieces needed to unlock the ancient treasure.
